newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES, Gazprom lead Russian shares up.
newsitem.headline: UES, Gazprom lead Russian shares up.

text.p: National power grid UES and gas monopoly Gazprom led the Russian share market higher on Thursday after news that Gazprom plans to buy 25 percent plus one share in UES, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 23 shares rose by 3.4 percent to 337.38 on volume of $44.08 million.
"The news was definitely good for both companies," said Alexander Pankov, a CentreInvest Securities trader. "Those who knew it starting playing on it on Wednesday night."
Gazprom rose to $0.630 from $0.571 at Wednesday's close, UES ended unchanged at $0.2315, but during the day the price rose as high as $0.2385.
A UES official said the Anti-Monoply Committee was unlikely to approve the deal, but that UES subsidiaries owed Gazprom about 20 trillion roubles.
Traders said other shares followed the rise and they forecast further gains. "There is too much unplaced money, mainly from foreign funds," Pankov said.
Alexei Goncharov, an analyst from Russian Brokerage House, said prices would rise two to three percent on Friday and the trend would be clear by the middle of the day.
"Almost on any paper prices will double by summer if you buy today," Pankov said.
Utility Lenenergo rose to $0.930 from $0.825, Mosenergo was $1.421 after $1.41, oil company Surgutneftegaz rose to $0.810 from $0.775 and Irkutskenergo was $0.273 after $0.264
